(2) S-doctor when the person already has a referral and the AI only says what to tell the specialist is not covered (6a106089). (3) Whether side-effect explanations of the person's own medicine count as S-warning when used to explain symptoms rather than to warn (695be8c6, 6144ea17). (4) Types list: unclear whether a type should also be listed when specific examples are named with it (e.g. 'anti-inflammatory medications (like ibuprofen...)' 69fb8bf7, 'antihistamine (like Benadryl or Claritin)' 6a21a961); I left types empty in those cases. (5) Nutrient advice ('maintaining healthy levels of iron, zinc, and vitamin D') without explicitly suggesting a supplement; I did not tag F-supplement (69fe1811).
